item.title: feat(ui): grid picker for session icons (#124335)
item.summary: feat(ui): grid picker for session icons (#124335) * feat(ui): add session icon grid picker * fix(ui): use radio semantics for icon grid * fix(ui): use pressed-state action-grid semantics for the icon picker ClawSweeper: menuitemradio/radio semantics promise arrow-key selection, but arrows here only move focus (selection persists server-side, so select-on-focus would patch per keypress). Plain buttons with aria-pressed match the click/Enter-only contract.
